mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shared_routines ( share_code, routine_json, routine_name, routine_type ) VALUES ( #{shareCode}, CAST(#{jsonString} AS jsonb), #{req.routineName}, COALESCE(#{req.routineType}, 'lite') )
mapper.select: SELECT share_code AS shareCode, routine_name AS routineName, routine_type AS routineType, routine_json::text AS routineJson FROM shared_routines WHERE share_code = #{shareCode} AND is_active = TRUE AND ( expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) LIMIT 1
